title: Another One!... 1994 FZJ80 LS/4L60E Swap (Budget, Hopefully)
transmission: 2WD 4L60E via Mark's 4WD adapter to factory HF2A transfer case
ai_summary: 1994 FZJ80 swap using an LQ4 6.0L pulled from a 2002 GMC Yukon XL Denali (~300k miles, still holding 40psi oil pressure at idle) to replace a 1FZ-FE that blew its head gasket at 300k miles. The donor's AWD 4L60E had the wrong spud shaft, so a separate 2WD 4L60E was sourced and mated to the factory HF2A transfer case via a Mark's 4WD adapter, targeting a sub-$2,000 out-of-pocket budget.

complications.detail: Donor Yukon transmission was an AWD unit with the wrong spud shaft; had to source a separate 2WD 4L60E, and the Mark's 4WD adapter was on a months-long backorder from Advance Adapters
Special oil pan sourced to clear the front driveshaft; universal exhaust manifolds chosen hoping to clear the frame rails
Throttle body converted from drive-by-wire to drive-by-cable; ECU being reprogrammed and harness stripped/simplified
